title: Store odd A-ended fragments to remove one terminal cyclization channel
statement: An alternating homobifunctional AA/BB chain has equal terminal port types exactly at odd length. Maintaining completed A-ended odd fragments and merging left+B+right preserves odd A-ended output; a target2N-1 chain uses N A leaves and N-1 B connectors. Such completed intermediates lack complementary terminal CuAAC partners.

requires: Valid alternating AA/BB homobifunctional chemistry and completed correctly oriented A-ended odd fragments.
The asserted exclusion concerns only complementary terminal A-B CuAAC; odd recursive fusion uses one B between two such inputs.
provides: An alternating homobifunctional AA/BB chain has equal terminal port types exactly at odd length. Maintaining completed A-ended odd fragments and merging left+B+right preserves odd A-ended output; a target2N-1 chain uses N A leaves and N-1 B connectors. Such completed intermediates lack complementary terminal CuAAC partners.
assumptions: No claim about all cyclization chemistry, safe unfinished joins, masking or correct ternary fusion.
costs: N A leaves and N-1 B bridges before failed-attempt costs; actual protection/passivation and port competence need evidence.
contract.units: Word length/port types are discrete; parity does not supply a kinetic selectivity or yield.
contract.obstruction: Acquire a bridge protocol selecting the intended inner ends and validate side chemistry separately.

body: An alternating chain starts/ends in the same monomer type iff its length is odd. If both inputs are A-ended alternating odd words, left+B+right is alternating, odd and A-ended. This is a representation invariant for COMPLETED valid fragments. It excludes only terminal azide-alkyne cyclization, not Glaser/side chemistry, wrong bonds, incomplete intermediates or transient bridge loops. An even target needs a separate B finishing step with its remaining port consumed/passivated. During fusion the two inputs expose four A ports, and safe storage alone says nothing about which two the connector chooses.

evidence.range_scope: Odd A-ended completed fragments avoid only terminal A-B click cyclization.
evidence.quote: E. NEW POLARITY/TOPOLOGY OBSTRUCTION IN AA/BB CLICK FRAGMENT FUSION
evidence.status: Exact frozen source bytes; scientific acceptance is scoped to actual version-bound review.

evidence.range_scope: Four exposed ends, stationary bridge hazards, whole-two-bond acceptance costs and missing masking.
evidence.quote: DECISIVE FAILURE OF THE UNMASKED BRIDGE: In the bridge step, each A-ended input fragment exposes two A ports, while B has two identical B ports. There are four candidate A ports; only two are intended: left fragment's right port and right fragment's left port. In a symmetric sequential without-replacement port-selection toy model, there are C(4,2)=6 equally probable endpoint pairs. One creates correct fusion, two consume both termini of the same fragment and make a ring, and three create wrong orientations/crosslinks. Therefore correct=1/6, ring=1/3, other wrong=1/2. This is not a prediction of real collision rates, but demonstrates that safe completed endpoints DO NOT ensure safe ternary fusion.

review.scope: Completed source-exposed intake-author reconstruction of covalent graph connectivity versus identity; renewal rebuild and independent accepted-junction purity, explicit total-product-size steric exponent and boundary-independent optimal-tree substructure; odd-fragment endpoint parity and exhaustive four-port counterconstruction; stationary two-click hazard law; independent exponential-clock Laplace/Jensen and conditional-deadline argument. The entire acquired1023-word library was independently checked over522753 unordered pairs: distinct length10 ACGT strings, min aligned Hamming3, GC4-6 and no homopolymer triple. Small exact rational checks verify model recurrence/parity/port/DP scope without executing original research programs. Correct-pair success versus acceptance and total-product versus child length are explicit qualifications, not silently blended. Three original programs were fully read, not run; missing import, numerical simulations, primary chemistry papers, measured performance, novelty and practical advantage are outside acceptance.
